NO_BOOKS_FOUND: No books yet. Add one with the “+” button, scan a barcode, or sync your Goodreads library.
RENDER_ERROR: Couldn't display the gallery. Check the console for details.
ADD_ISBN_DESC: Type or paste an ISBN, then look it up. You can also scan the barcode.
ADD_MANUAL_HEADER: Or fill in the details manually:
ADD_NOT_FOUND: No book found for that ISBN in the databases. Just fill in the details below.
SETTINGS_APIKEY_DESC: Makes ISBN lookups reliable, especially for Portuguese/European books. Without it the free shared quota is often exhausted. Get a free key at console.cloud.google.com → enable the Books API → create an API key.
ADD_DUPLICATE: That book is already in your library.
SCAN_HINT: Point the camera at the book's barcode.
SCAN_UNSUPPORTED: In-app scanning isn't available here. On iPhone/iPad, use the Shortcut method (see settings). On desktop, a modern browser engine is required.
SCAN_CAMERA_DENIED: Couldn't access the camera. Check permissions, or use the Shortcut / manual entry.
STAT_NO_GENRES: No genre data. Import books by ISBN to get genres.
CONFIGURE_RSS: Please configure your GoodReads RSS URL in settings.
SETTINGS_RSS_DESC: Copy your "My Books" RSS feed URL from GoodReads.
SETTINGS_FOLDER_DESC: Folder where book notes will be created.
SETTINGS_FORCE_SYNC_DESC: Manually sync your GoodReads library now.
SETTINGS_GALLERY_TAB_DESC: The title displayed at the top of the gallery view.
SETTINGS_VIEW_NAME_DESC: The display name of the gallery tab.
SETTINGS_INBOX_DESC: Path to the file your iOS Shortcut appends scanned barcodes to. Each ISBN on the file is imported and the file is cleared.
SETTINGS_INBOX_CREATE_DESC: Create the inbox file in your vault so the Shortcut has a target.
SETTINGS_INBOX_NEED_PATH: Set an inbox file path first.
SETTINGS_INBOX_PROCESS_DESC: Import any barcodes currently in the inbox file.
SETTINGS_SHORTCUT_HELP: Set up an iOS Shortcut to scan books straight into your library:
SETTINGS_SHORTCUT_STEPS: Create a new Shortcut in the Shortcuts app.|Add the action “Scan QR/Barcode” (or “Scan Document”).|Add “Append to File”, point it at the inbox file above (inside your Obsidian vault folder), and append the scanned result followed by a new line.|Optionally add it to your Home Screen or Back Tap.|Scan a book — next time Obsidian opens (or immediately if it's running), the book is imported.
